body:
I think people having podman installed these days, do so because they prefer it over docker:

```suggestion
if [[ -z $ENGINE ]]; then
  if command -v podman &>/dev/null; then
    ENGINE=podman
  elif command -v docker &>/dev/null; then
    ENGINE=docker
  else
    echo "No podman or docker in PATH" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
```
